security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https: asset:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: Lightweight Windows Dynamic Island with Google Antigravity quota monitoring.
bundle.longDescription: KODI is a minimal, elegant, and high-performance Windows desktop application inspired by Apple's Dynamic Island and the macOS notch. Living discreetly at the top-center of the Windows desktop as a floating pill, KODI expands smoothly to present Google Antigravity AI quota monitoring, Spotify and native media controls, hardware telemetry, and productivity quick actions.
